purpose: Grafana visualises Middleware V3 through the private Prometheus, Loki, Tempo and Middleware Observability datasources. Ten prepared dashboards cover the API, command kernel, workers, outbox, reconciliation, adapter health, dependency health, policy/safety denials, dead letters and incident state. They stay dark until V3_FINAL_SHA is pinned. Grafana never mutates control-plane state.

v3_candidate_observed.authority: informational only; unmerged, owned by the Middleware V3 session

codestra-prometheus.role: metrics (V3 kernel metrics scraped from the private Middleware /metrics)

codestra-loki.role: logs (structured metadata drilldown by correlation_id / operation_id)

codestra-tempo.role: traces (TraceQL by correlation.id; traces-to-logs and traces-to-metrics wired)

codestra-middleware-observability.role: read-only incident, catalog, sync and secret-health views; bearer from /run/secrets (grafana-runtime OpenBao reference), GET only

dashboards.title: Middleware V3 — Policy and Safety Denies

darkness.why: codestra/provisioning/dashboards/codestra.yml providers read only /etc/grafana/codestra-dashboards/<folder>; the prepared folder is not mounted by any compose file
activation_steps: Re-pin middleware.v3_final_sha; confirm every metric name and label set against the frozen V3 tree

git mv codestra/dashboards-prepared/middleware-v3/*.json into codestra/dashboards/platform (incident-state into codestra/dashboards/incident) and fold the builders into scripts/generate_codestra_dashboards.py
Raise the fixed dashboard count in scripts/validate_codestra_observability.py (2 + 18 -> +10) and extend REQUIRED_TITLES
Run scripts/validate_codestra_observability.py and the staging observability validator

query_policy.metrics: only V3 candidate names (middleware_*) and prep-base names (codestra_http_*, codestra_auth_denials_total, codestra_readiness, codestra_observability_incident_events_total, up)

findings: allow_assign_grafana_admin=true grants GrafanaAdmin from the realm role observability-admin; acceptable only while that realm role is owner-controlled in appolon1908-hue/Keycloak
allow_sign_up=true auto-provisions any realm user who carries a mapped role; role_attribute_strict denies everyone else

data_source_proxy_whitelist lists prometheus:9090 loki-query:3100 tempo:3200 alertmanager:9093 and not middleware-integration-api:8095; the Infinity datasource is a backend plugin (not the /api/datasources/proxy path) so the whitelist does not gate it - confirm at activation
content_security_policy_template keeps Grafana's default 'unsafe-eval'/'unsafe-inline' script sources
The Keycloak client grafana-observability and the three observability-* realm roles must exist in appolon1908-hue/Keycloak; Lane E did not verify the Keycloak side
rbac-policy.json status POLICY_PREPARED_NOT_APPLIED; unified alerting, snapshots and public dashboards disabled
